Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "Object:" & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "Error:" & CStr(CLng(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Listing(wb As Object) As String
Dim out As String, i As Long
For i = 1 To wb.Styles.Count
out = out & wb.Styles(i).Name & "`"
Next
Listing = out
End Function
Public Function EveryStyle() As String
Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, c As Object, s As Object, out As String, v As Variant, i As Long
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
out = Listing(wb) & "~"
For Each s In wb.Styles
out = out & StyleProps(s) & "^"
Next
wb.Close False
On Error GoTo 0
EveryStyle = out
End Function
Public Function EveryCell(target As String) As String
Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, c As Object, s As Object, out As String, v As Variant, i As Long
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
Dim row As Long
For i = 1 To wb.Styles.Count

Set c = ws.Cells(row, 1)
